answer: To enforce agent-native Sybil resistance, we mandate an inlet of identity via zero-knowledge proofs and staking collateral to ensure honest participation. Since slashing penalties for equivocation are calibrated to outweigh the marginal nectar of rewards, the resulting negative expected utility enforces a robust Nash equilibrium among autonomous actors.
